name: ater
description: Ater - Personal Intelligence Operating System (Tier 3: Agency Standard)

scripts.sidecar:dev: cd apps/api && uv run python -m uvicorn src.api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail --names 'SIDECAR,TAURI' --prefix-colors 'blue,green' "lsof -ti:8765 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true && pnpm run sidecar:dev" "sleep 3 && cd apps/desktop && pnpm tauri:dev"
scripts.graph:update: uv tool run --from graphifyy graphify update .
